source.title: Carolina - Candlelight Specter
source.name: Carolina
source.description: A Mage who is skilled at controlling enemies and dealing extra damage to enemies under control effects.

skills.name: Frozen Grave

description.raw: Carolina selects an enemy after charging up briefly, dealing 240% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to the target and freezing them for 6s. Then, she creates an arctic field that inflicts Frostbite on the targed and enemies within 2 tiles every 2s, Carolina prioritizes selecting the target with the most enemies in their surrounding 2 tiles, and each stack of Frostbite reduces the target's Haste by 15 for 6s, up to 3 stacks.
active: Carolina selects an enemy after charging up briefly, dealing 240% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to the target and freezing them for 6s.

Then, she creates an arctic field that inflicts Frostbite on the targed and enemies within 2 tiles every 2s, Carolina prioritizes selecting the target with the most enemies in their surrounding 2 tiles, and each stack of Frostbite reduces the target's Haste by 15 for 6s, up to 3 stacks.

text: Unlocks at level 51: Increases damage to 260% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 111: Increases frozen duration to 8s.
Unlocks at level 171: Increases damage to 270% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 231: Increases damage to 280% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Carolina deals damage to and freezes an enemy, and creates an arctic field that inflicts Frostbite.

skills.name: Freezing Nova

description.raw: Carolina deals 155% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage to a target and adjacent enemies and inflicts a Frostbite stack.
active: Carolina deals 155% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage to a target and adjacent enemies and inflicts a Frostbite stack.

text: Unlocks at level 71: Increases damage to 165% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 131: Increases damage to 175% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 191: Increases damage to 185% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Carolina deals damage to a small area and inflicts Frostbite.

skills.name: Snowball Witchery

description.raw: Carolina surrounds herself with 4 snowballs and automatically shoots a snowball to attack enemies every 3s, dealing 130% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage to the targets under control effects. Each enemy can be attacked by a snowball every 2.5s. Carolina creates more snowballs when they are all used up.
active: Carolina surrounds herself with 4 snowballs and automatically shoots a snowball to attack enemies every 3s, dealing 130% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage to the targets under control effects.
Each enemy can be attacked by a snowball every 2.5s.
Carolina creates more snowballs when they are all used up.

text: Unlocks at level 91: Increases damage to 140% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 151: Increases damage to 150% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 211: Reduces each snowball attack on each enemy to 1.5s.

skills.description_lite: Carolina surrounds herself with snowballs which automatically attack enemies under control effects.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Carolina increases her Crit by 14 during battle. She gains an extra 18 Crit after casting Snowball Witchery 5 times.

skills.description_lite: Carolina increases her Crit during battle. She gains extra Crit after casting Snowball Witchery multiple times.

skills.name: Ice Vortex

description.raw: Carolina permanently increases the snowballs' damage by 10% with each cast of Snowball Witchery, up to 7 times. Starting from the third cast, Carolina deals AoE damage to adjacent tiles with newly produced snowballs and reduces enemies' Magic DEF by 15% for 6s.
active: Carolina permanently increases the snowballs' damage by 10% with each cast of Snowball Witchery, up to 7 times.
Starting from the third cast, Carolina deals AoE damage to adjacent tiles with newly produced snowballs and reduces enemies' Magic DEF by 15% for 6s.

text: Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon level 5: Uses a snowball to attack the same controlled enemy hit by Carolina's normal attacks.
Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon level 10: Increases the Magic DEF reduction to 25%.
Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon level 15: Increases the Magic DEF reduction to 30%.
